purpose: Extend the controlled legal-professional denominator with source-confirmed historic/cross-border legal professionals and firm engagements discovered after the 40-record canonical register was frozen. Supplement keys are not immutable CAEPR identity IDs.
rules: A supplement entry does not silently allocate or reuse a PD-SP-P/O immutable identity ID.
Source-confirmed legal services or a formal engagement may be analysed immediately, while identity federation remains a separate controlled step.
Proposal, onboarding, conflict-check and introductory contacts are not classified as former counsel unless substantive accepted work or a retainer is evidenced.
Firm-level work does not transfer knowledge, conduct, intent or responsibility to every named professional.
Private email addresses, provider message IDs and privileged advice are not copied into this public-safe supplement.
